name: Rejold Barleybrew
summary: At Brewnall Village, Rejold Barleybrew keeps working toward the perfect mountain spirit. He gathers ingredients from western Dun Morogh and tests each recipe.

sections.title: A Master of the Craft
sections.body: Dwarves in Dun Morogh take brewing seriously. Rejold works in Brewnall Village, near the frozen lake of the Iceflow River. He keeps refining his blends with rare hops, mountain minerals, and pristine ice water. His aim is a stout hearty enough to warm even the stoutest dwarven warriors.

sections.title: The Search for the Perfect Stout
sections.body: Rejold seeks the right flavors for drinks such as Shimmer Stout. He sends travelers across Dun Morogh for ingredients and trades favors with the siege pilots of Steelgrill's Depot. He also arranges deliveries to thirsty patrons. So hearty ale keeps flowing along Dun Morogh's cold, trogg-plagued roads.

faq.answer: Rejold Barleybrew brews ales in Brewnall Village, Dun Morogh. He works to perfect his recipes and sends travelers to gather ingredients and deliver experimental brews.

faq.q: Where can Rejold Barleybrew be found?
faq.answer: Rejold Barleybrew can be found in Brewnall Village, in western Dun Morogh beside the frozen waters of the Iceflow Basin.
Rejold is perfecting potent mountain recipes, including Shimmer Stout and other experimental ales. He needs cold mountain flora and brewing components from across the snowy hills.

faq.q: Why does Rejold send travelers to gnomes?
faq.answer: Rejold's errands connect him to fellow dwarves, not gnomes. Pilot Bellowfiz of Steelgrill's Depot sends travelers to Rejold for Evershine, while Rejold's Shimmer Stout goes to his brother, Mountaineer Barleybrew.
Shimmer Stout is a potent dwarven drink brewed by Rejold Barleybrew. Its mountain ingredients give it a distinctive kick in freezing winter weather.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know Rejold's work belongs to Khaz Modan's mountaineering tradition. Strong ales bring warmth and strength against the bitter winter chill.
As a cook, you can appreciate Rejold's care with ingredients and recipes. He treats brewing as a precise and venerable art.
As an Alliance traveler, you can count on Rejold's stout to lift spirits across Dun Morogh. It strengthens guards and travelers facing trogg raids and harsh blizzards.
